# SinapsAI (In-Process AI Gateway & Control Plane)

> Zero-dependency in-process AI Gateway and Control Plane for TypeScript, Node.js 18+, Bun, Deno, and Edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge). Connects to 15 top LLM providers through a unified OpenAI-compatible API with in-memory circuit breakers, multi-strategy dynamic routing, speculative hedged requests, PII/security guardrails, KV-cache tracking, MCP tool bridge, and multi-agent swarm with A2A handoff.

- **Author**: Roedy Rustam <roedyrustam.id@gmail.com>
- **License**: MIT
- **Runtime Dependencies**: 0 (Zero external dependencies, pure Web Standards)
- **Overhead**: < 5ms in-process execution overhead, sub-millisecond cache hits (<0.08ms clustered cache)
- **Test Suite**: 681 unit & integration tests passing across 67 test suites (100% pass rate)
- **Quality**: 100% Biome Clean across 146 files, TypeScript strict mode

## Core Capabilities

- **Unified Late-2026 Frontier Model Registry (`FrontierModelRegistry`, `FRONTIER_MODELS`)**: 4-tier execution catalog (`high-fast`, `fast`, `medium`, `high`) covering Gemini 4 Carbon/Neon/Hydrogen/Argon/Pro & 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet/Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, Opus 4.7, Sonnet/Opus 4.6, GPT-5.6 Sol Medium, GPT-5.5/5.4/5-mini/o3/o4-mini, Grok 4.7/4.6/4.3, DeepSeek V4 Pro/V4.1 Flash/V3.2, Alibaba Qwen 3 Max/Plus/Turbo/Coder/VL & QwQ Plus/32B, Moonshot Kimi K2 Thinking/256K/Turbo, Zhipu GLM-4.5/Air/Flash/4.5V, Mistral Large/Small 4 & Magistral, Cohere Command A Reasoning/Vision, and Groq Llama 4 / Qwen 3.8 with Availability Fallbacks.
- **15 Unified Providers + Frontier Protocols**: OpenAI (Chat Completions + Responses API `/v1/responses`, GPT-5 `max_completion_tokens`, `developer` role, `xhigh` effort), Anthropic Claude (Adaptive Thinking `type: 'adaptive'`, native `output_config.format` `json_schema`, 1h prompt cache TTL, 1M context), Google Gemini (`thinkingLevel`, `includeThoughts`, `thoughtSignature` preservation, Context Caching, Grounding), AWS Bedrock (SigV4 Web Crypto, Claude 5.5/Nova 2/Llama 4, Converse thinking & `cachePoint`), Azure OpenAI (Entra ID, `/openai/deployments/*` & `/openai/v1/*`, GPT-5), Alibaba Qwen (DashScope OpenAI-compatible mode, Qwen 3 Hybrid Thinking `enable_thinking`/`thinking_budget`, `enable_search`, QwQ `reasoning_content`, `text-embedding-v3`, Qwen-VL), Moonshot AI (Kimi K2 Thinking, `$web_search`), Zhipu AI (GLM-4.5 Hybrid Thinking, `web_search`, `embedding-3`), DeepSeek, Groq LPU, OpenRouter, Mistral AI, Ollama, xAI Grok (Live Search), Cohere v2 (`thinking`).
- **In-Process Clustered Semantic Cache (`client.clusteredCache`, `ClusteredSemanticCache`)**: Sub-0.08ms spherical K-means centroid index reducing semantic cache lookup from $O(N)$ linear scans to $O(K + N/K)$ with incremental centroid updates and monotonic sequence counter LRU eviction.
- **Swarm Multi-Model Tournament & Voting Consensus (`client.swarm.runTournament`, `TournamentConsensusEngine`)**: Multi-agent deliberation across diverse models, pairwise similarity matrix, majority/Borda/weighted voting, confidence scoring [0.0–1.0], minority dissent extraction, and automatic DPO pair distillation.
- **KV-Cache Prefix Pinning Optimizer (`client.kvCache`, `KvCacheOptimizer`)**: 3-tier prompt partitioning, automatic relocation of dynamic ISO timestamps to volatile tail `[RUNTIME_CONTEXT]`, deterministic tool canonicalization, and prompt cache hit/savings prediction.
- **In-Process Semantic Prompt Router (`client.semanticRouter`, `SemanticRouter`)**: Sub-millisecond vector centroid classification (<0.5ms) and automatic model routing directly to specialized LLMs (`claude-3-7-sonnet`, `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`, etc.) using L2-normalized 128-dim character 3-gram and token hashing with stop-word dampening.
- **Synthetic Dataset Distiller (`client.distiller`, `DatasetDistiller`)**: In-process curation and real-time generation of fine-tuning datasets from live production interactions, supporting HuggingFace/TRL DPO pairs (`recordDpo`) and OpenAI/Axolotl SFT conversations (`recordSft`) with integrated PII redaction (`PIIGuardrails`) and autonomous DPO pair recording in Actor-Critic swarm loops (`runActorCritic`).
- **Actor-Critic Consensus Swarm Loop (`client.swarm.runActorCritic`)**: Automated self-refining loop between worker and reviewer agents with score thresholds and live cycle callbacks.
- **Streaming Durable Workflows & Right-to-be-Forgotten Checkpoint Deletion (`client.workflows`)**: Real-time workflow step event streaming (`onStep`) and permanent checkpoint purging (`deleteWorkflow`) compliant with UU PDP No. 27/2022 and GDPR Art. 17.
- **Steganography Firewall 2.0 (`securityGuardrails`)**: Real-time neutralization of hidden Zero-Width characters, ASCII tag smuggling, and Bidi text direction overrides with NFKC normalization.
- **Embedded Web UI & Telemetry Dashboard (`client.dashboard` / `sinapsai dashboard`)**: Zero-dependency in-process HTTP dashboard on port 3140 with real-time KPI metrics, provider status, canary prober states, rolling request history, and REST API.
- **Hallucination & Faithfulness Sentinel (`createGroundingVerified` / `client.sentinel`)**: In-process atomic claim extraction, RAG grounding verification gate, faithfulness scoring (0.0 to 1.0), and automatic escalation to stronger models.
- **Active Canary Health Probing (`client.canary`)**: Background heartbeat probes preventing tail latency spikes by tripping circuit breakers before user traffic arrives.
- **Standard Schema v1 & Zod Direct Resolver (`createStructured`)**: Direct validation using Standard Schema v1, Zod, or JSON Schema with zero runtime dependencies.
- **Speculative Multi-Draft Consensus & AI Arbitration (`client.consensus.create`)**: Parallel speculative drafting across diverse models, in-process pairwise cosine similarity, and automatic escalation to a Supreme AI Judge Model upon divergence.
- **In-Process Episodic Vector Memory (`client.memory`)**: Long-term fact store with multi-tenant user isolation, subword n-gram cosine matching, and dynamic prompt injection (`injectIntoMessages`).
- **In-Process Hybrid RAG (`client.rag`)**: Okapi BM25 keyword precision + dense vector cosine similarity combined via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with semantic paragraph chunking.
- **Real-Time Multimodal Voice & WebSocket Client (`client.realtime.connect`)**: Zero-dependency native WebSocket connectivity to OpenAI Realtime GA (`gpt-realtime`) and Gemini Live `v1beta` (`BidiGenerateContent`, `gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview`, `sendVideoFrame`, `serverContent` thinking/transcription/interruption) with bi-directional audio/text delta streaming.
- **Agent Swarm with Micro-Economy Wallets (`client.swarm`)**: Role-based autonomous specialists, A2A handoffs (`transfer_to_<agent>`), parallel fan-out with atomic context deep-merge (`deepMergeContext`), hard USD & token budget wallets per agent (`SwarmAgentWallet`), dynamic `reasoningEffort`/`thinkingLevel`, and Linux Foundation A2A Agent Card exporter (`exportAgentCards()`).
- **MCP `2025-06-18` Tool Bridge, Streamable HTTP & Sampling (`client.mcp`, `McpToolBridge`, `McpClientConnector`)**: Protocol negotiation for `'2025-06-18'`, `sampling/createMessage` server-initiated sampling RPC + default handler in `SinapsClient`, `'streamable-http'` transport with `Mcp-Session-Id` & SSE responses, automatic argument coercion, and schema-guided self-healing hints (`AutonomousDriftHealer`).
- **6 Dynamic Routing Strategies**: `adaptive` (smart-hybrid multi-factor reliability/latency/cost), `lowest-cost` (dual-pricing prompt vs completion tokens), `lowest-latency` (moving average latency with auto-probing), `failover` (strict priority), `load-balance` (round-robin).
- **In-Process Circuit Breaker**: Anti-cascading fault isolation (`CLOSED` -> `OPEN` -> `HALF_OPEN`) with anti-thundering-herd strict single canary probing.
- **In-Process Gateway Rate Limiter**: Zero-dependency sliding-window counter enforcing RPM and TPM globally, per-user, per-model, and per-provider with post-response token adjustment across streaming & non-streaming.
- **Speculative Hedged Requests (`HedgedExecutor`)**: Fires backup requests after `delayMs` to eliminate P99 tail latencies on redundant providers.
- **In-Process Guardrails**:
  - `PIIGuardrails`: Zero-dependency detection & redaction (emails, phones, Luhn-verified credit cards, SSN, IP, IBAN, passports, JWT, URLs) with Reversible Tokenization Vault in both non-streaming and streaming.
  - `SecurityGuardrails`: Heuristic defense against prompt injection, jailbreaks, delimiter hijacking, and system role tampering (ReDoS safe).
  - `BudgetGuardrails`: FinOps spend tracking enforcing hard USD caps (`maxCostUsd`) and token limits (`maxTotalTokens`).
- **Context Compression (`ContextCompressor`)**: Intelligent trimming (`sliding-window`, `middle-out`) preserving system instructions and atomic tool groups.
- **Universal LLM Optimization Engine (LLMO)**:
  - Code-block-aware prompt minification (lossless & aggressive whitespace pruning).
  - System instruction deduplication.
  - Deterministic KV-cache prefix alignment & tool schema canonicalization.
  - Multi-signal complexity analysis & 3-tier model cascading (`tier1: fast/cheap`, `tier2: standard`, `tier3: deep reasoning`), including `FRONTIER_CASCADE_PRESETS` (`'frontier'`, `'cost-optimized'`, `'speed-first'`).
  - Dynamic thinking budget & `recommendedReasoningEffort` allocation & FinOps savings telemetry (`client.getMetrics().llmoMetrics`).
- **Vercel AI SDK Adapter (`sinapsai/ai-sdk`)**: Native `LanguageModelV1`, `LanguageModelV2` (AI SDK v5), `LanguageModelV3` (AI SDK v6), and `EmbeddingModelV1` adapters (`createSinapsAI`, `createSinapsAIV2`, `createSinapsAIV3`) supporting reasoning parts, tool calling, and structured token metrics.
- **Telemetry Exporters**: Native Prometheus / OpenMetrics (`exportPrometheusMetrics`), OpenTelemetry OTLP JSON (`exportOtelMetrics`, including `reasoning` tokens), and OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions v1.30+ distributed traces (`exportOtelTraces`).

## Installation

```bash
npm install sinapsai
```

## Quickstart

```typescript
import {
  SinapsClient,
  OpenAiProvider,
  AnthropicProvider,
  GeminiProvider,
  GroqProvider,
} from 'sinapsai';

const client = new SinapsClient({
  strategy: 'adaptive', // multi-factor reliability, latency, cost scoring
  providers: [
    new OpenAiProvider({ apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY }),
    new AnthropicProvider({ apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }),
    new GeminiProvider({ apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY }),
    new GroqProvider({ apiKey: process.env.GROQ_API_KEY }),
  ],
  circuitBreaker: {
    failureThreshold: 3,
    resetTimeoutMs: 30000,
  },
  hedging: {
    enabled: true,
    delayMs: 250, // Cut P99 tail latencies
  },
  llmo: {
    enabled: true,
    minifyPrompts: true,
    autoCascadeModel: true, // Route simple to flash-lite, complex to pro/reasoning
  },
  piiGuardrails: {
    enabled: true,
    reversible: true, // Restore original PII in response
  },
});

// 1. OpenAI-compatible chat completion
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'auto', // LLMO dynamically selects optimal tier model
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Explain distributed consensus in Raft' }],
});
console.log(res.choices[0].message.content);

// 2. Real-time streaming
const stream = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'gemini-3.8-flash',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Stream this response' }],
  stream: true,
});
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.content || '');
}
```
